title: Customer support resolution agent
stem: An online retailer runs a support agent built on the Claude Agent SDK. Customers write in about returns, billing disputes and account problems, often several at once and rarely with all the details. The agent reaches the retailer's systems only through four custom MCP tools: `get_customer`, `lookup_order`, `process_refund` and `escalate_to_human`. The goal is to resolve at least 80% of contacts on first contact while still handing the right cases to a human.

title: Code generation with Claude Code
stem: A product engineering team of about twenty developers has adopted Claude Code across a mid-sized TypeScript and Python monorepo. They use it to write new features, refactor, chase bugs and keep documentation current. The team lead wants shared conventions in CLAUDE.md, a handful of team slash commands and skills, and a clear rule of thumb for when a change should start in plan mode rather than be made directly.

title: Multi-agent research system
stem: An analyst team uses a research system built on the Claude Agent SDK. A coordinator agent breaks each research question down and hands the pieces to specialised subagents: one searches the web, one analyses supplied documents, one synthesises findings and one writes the final report. Reports must be thorough and every claim must carry a citation a reader can follow back to its source.

title: Developer productivity agent
stem: A platform team is building an internal assistant on the Claude Agent SDK for engineers who join unfamiliar or legacy services. It explores codebases, explains how old modules fit together, generates boilerplate and automates repetitive chores. It works with the built-in tools (Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob) and connects to several MCP servers, including the company's issue tracker and documentation site.

title: Claude Code in the CI pipeline
stem: A company runs Claude Code inside its CI/CD pipeline. On every pull request it reviews the change, proposes or generates tests and posts feedback as review comments. Developers will only keep reading those comments if they are specific and actionable, so the pipeline's prompts and configuration are tuned to keep false positives low.

title: Structured data extraction pipeline
stem: A finance operations group is building a pipeline that uses Claude to pull structured records out of unstructured documents such as supplier invoices, purchase contracts and scanned statements. Every output is validated against a JSON schema before it is loaded into downstream accounting systems. Accuracy has to stay high, and odd layouts, missing fields and contradictory documents must be handled rather than guessed.

title: Code Generation with Claude Code
stem: Your team uses Claude Code for code generation, refactoring, debugging, and documentation, integrated into daily development with custom slash commands and CLAUDE.md configuration — and you must judge when plan mode beats direct execution.

title: Multi-Agent Research System
